## Facts and statements

- [statement] Prompt pre-fill evaluates GEMM operations where high arithmetic intensity (FLOPs/byte > 100) saturates GPU tensor cores and scales linearly with compute clock frequencies. (high confidence) — https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm · keywords: GEMM Compute Scaling vs GEMV Memory-Bandwidth Bounds · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx/blob/main/docs/src/usage/benchmarks.rst
- [statement] Auto-regressive decoding executes GEMV operations with minimal arithmetic intensity (FLOPs/byte approx. 1), causing GPU compute ALUs to sit idle while awaiting memory bus DRAM/GDDR reads. (high confidence) — https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm · keywords: GEMM Compute Scaling vs GEMV Memory-Bandwidth Bounds · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx/blob/main/docs/src/usage/benchmarks.rst
